reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the structural hypotheses batch for use-case-structural-hypotheses-experiments: 100 records (50 results, 19 evaluations, 13 configurations, 9 claims including 6 relevance judgements, 4 protocols, 3 datasets, 2 sources). All 27 Fromm et al. 2026 Table 1 cells and all 23 Smorodina et al. 2026 prose values checked against the paragraph each locator names; the two FoldBench protocols and their stored evaluations checked for status, links and fit. See docs/reviews/use-cases/structural-hypotheses-experiments-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any prediction.
The Smorodina supplementary tables were not retrieved, so the per-system quadrant assignments behind the calibration shares could not be checked.
The two FoldBench judgements reuse stored evaluations reviewed in an earlier batch; their values were not re-checked against FoldBench here.
Relevance judgement pins are left unset for the integrator; all eleven judgements on the use case were simulated active after re-pinning, with the approved use-case text applied in memory.

errors.message: The four oracle evaluations (DockQ, aeTM, aeiTM, aeRankConf) are excluded with reasons: each needs the experimental structure, so none is a selection rule a user could apply. The endpoint now names only the five computable scores; the gap stays in claim structural-20261009-claim-fromm2026-top-vs-best.

Source warning added: section 3.5 gives the mean per-target correlation as 0.28 while Table 1 prints 0.214 for the same quantity. The table names its statistic and the text does not, so the table value is kept and the conflict travels with the result.

Comparison groups split by complex class: the three nanobody strata moved to their own group, because their own limitations say results do not transfer to conventional antibodies. The antibody-antigen group keeps the FoldBench and Fromm strata.
The 'Table 1 does not state the number of models' limitation replaced: Methods 2.2.2 and section 2.4 state 200 models per complex, so the reading is stated, not inferred.
Training-cutoff limitation rewritten precisely (Chai-1 earliest, Boltz-2 latest, October 2021 matches AF3) and kept as a limitation, not a source concern; preprint status added as its own limitation.
Shuffled-pairing count conflict recorded: the abstract gives 11,342, Results P8 gives 11,130. No stored value uses either.
Added limitation: the mapped evaluations are stored records reviewed in an earlier batch; this review checked status, links and fit, not their values.
The approved exclusion changes a pinned field; the five existing judgements hold but must be re-pinned with the six new ones.
